title: 抽骨之夜与黑匣初鸣（公开范例）

acts.title: 寒夜绝境与黑匣初鸣
acts.bgm_prompt: Dark Chinese xianxia cinematic score, solo xiao flute and low cello drone building tension in cold rain, no vocals, instrumental

cues.text: [dramatically] 沈渊一口心头血喷在锁骨下的暗金烙印上—— [shouting] 九重镇狱黑匣，轰然开启！
cues.director_note: 高潮破局旁白，Creative 0.0 激发标签张力

cues.sfx_prompt: Ancient heavy bronze reliquary mechanism unlocking with deep metallic resonance and dark sub-bass boom
cues.director_note: 前景独立音效轨，不随人声闪避

cues.text: [desperately] 开第一层！ [shouting] 用我十年阳寿，换你一缕斩铁剑意！
cues.director_note: 识海空间混响微染，绝境嘶吼
